scripts.pc:serve: npm run build && npm run dev:server -w @nikkisync/pc-companion
scripts.pc:exe: npm run build && npm run package:windows -w @nikkisync/pc-companion
scripts.release:bundle: npm run mobile:build && npm run pc:exe && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -Force '.\apps\mobile\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' '.\release\NikkiSync\NikkiSync-Android.apk'"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:protocol && npm run build:database && npm run build:pc
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:protocol && npm run build:database && npm run typecheck -w @nikkisync/pc-companion
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-isolation=none packages/core/dist/test/resolver.test.js packages/core/dist/test/metadata-dictionary.test.js packages/protocol/dist/test/protocol.test.js packages/database/dist/test/database.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/game-directory-discovery.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/scanner.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/local-sync-server.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/metadata-resolver.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/metadata-dictionary.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/metadata-dictionary-provider.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/app-data-directory.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/windows-app.test.js apps/pc-companion/dist/test/qr.test.js tools/sample-analyzer/test/analyzer.test.mjs
